payout_quote: Figma & FigJam are 100% free for students, educators and schools. No freemium or hidden upgrades, ever. K12 districts qualify for free access to the Enterprise tier. Higher education institutions and bootcamps qualify for free access to the Professional tier. ... This will give you free access to the Figma Professional tier.
timing: Free access granted after education-status verification and Education team setup.
eligibility: Teachers and students over 13 in a structured classroom (high schools, universities, post-graduate institutions, trade schools, bootcamps, design/coding academies); must verify education status at Figma.com/education/apply.
catches: Free software access, not cash — this saves the cost of a paid tier but never pays you.
Access requires re-verification and ends when you leave school.
Under-13 students need their school to sign Figma's terms for schools (Enterprise tier path).
steps: Go to https://www.figma.com/education/ and create a Figma account using your student or teacher email address.
Verify your education status at Figma.com/education/apply.
Create or join an Education team to get access to all professional paid tools.
Use Figma and FigJam at the Professional tier for free while verified.
biggest_catch: Free design software, not money — it saves a subscription cost but can never pay you.
notes: Verified on official FAQ. Route's $15 figure is meaningless — the benefit is 100% free access, i.e., a subscription-cost saving. Frame as savings, never income.
